title: Lash Slick Lift and Lengthen Tubing Mascara
descriptionHtml:
✓ Cruelty-Free✓ Fragrance Free✓ Lengthening

What it is: A long-wearing tubing mascara with a weightless, flexible formula for a lengthening, baby-extensions effect that won’t smudge or flake.


Formulation Type: Lengthening


Benefits: Long-wearing


Highlighted Ingredients:
- Japanese Fiber Technology: Consists of curved fibers that cling to lashes for added length.

- Vegan Biotin: Conditions for softer lashes over time.

- Natural Shine Polymers: Enhance black pigments for extra shiny, sleek lashes.

How to Use+
Suggested Usage:
-Use the brush with tiered bristles to comb mascara from lash roots to tips.
-Apply one coat for a natural look or two coats for more dramatic lashes.
-The flexible, weightless formula stays in place for up to 12 hours without flaking or smudging, but removes easily with warm water (and without harsh, damaging rubbing).
Ingredients+
-Japanese Fiber Technology: Consists of curved fibers that cling to lashes for added length.
-Vegan Biotin: Conditions for softer lashes over time.
-Natural Shine Polymers: Enhance black pigments for extra shiny, sleek lashes.

Water/Aqua/Eau, Acrylates Copolymer, Pullulan, Synthetic Beeswax, Palmitic Acid, Butylene Glycol, Stearic Acid, Behenyl Alcohol, Kaolin, Euphorbia Cerifera (Candelilla) Wax/Candelilla Cera/Cire de Candelilla, Bentonite, Rayon, Aminomethyl Propanediol, Caprylyl Glycol, Copernicia Cerifera (Carnauba) Wax/Cera Carnauba/Cire de Carnauba, Biotinoyl Tripeptide-1, Panthenol, Glycerin, Glyceryl Caprylate, VP/VA Copolymer, Bambusa Arundinacea Stem Powder, Propanediol, Sodium C14-16 Olefin Sulfonate, Silica, 1,2-Hexanediol, Black 2 (CI 77266), Iron Oxides (CI 77491, CI 77492, CI 77499).
